perObjectSizeMeaning: Uncompressed Git objectsize; every kind, all target ancestry and every newly missing set.
qualification: Raw bounds include all newly reachable commits, trees, blobs and tags from every parent. Every target-reachable and every newly missing object is capped at 32 MiB; each step is capped at 40 MiB raw content. These are not observed network pack sizes. The already-pushed source base is supplied by the operator and need not identify a deployed Site version; no remote lookup, credential access, push, package or deployment is performed.
executionNotes: Execute only a plan with status planned_not_pushed and checkoutUnchanged true.
Keep this plan and every helper archive outside the checkout.

Starting at the clean original HEAD, use a complete detached checkout of each step.commit, in order. Do not use an index-only reset/read-tree: future proof files left untracked would be staged by the standard helper.
A complete checkout removes tracked future proof files absent from that step. All non-deferred paths, including the final .gitignore and source/test/build inputs, are already final from step 1.
Before each standard Sites helper call, verify actual HEAD and tree equal that step and the tracked/untracked status is clean. Never force-add the separately listed ignored raw evidence.

The standard helper pushes current HEAD normally to remote main and verifies the remote result. Advance only after success; stop if the remote no longer matches the planned predecessor. Never force-push.
Run the Sites deployment only after the final helper source push. Intermediate helper source/archive calls must not be followed by an intermediate Site deployment.

The planner leaves the original branch untouched. Planned commit objects have no new refs; keep this plan and execute before pruning unreachable objects. The final commit directly retains the original HEAD.
